name: markdown-code-type
body: Extend code-type classification for markdown so documents are in the graph and filterable rather than dropped: the md frontend's files and section symbols classify as a docs provenance class for ordinary markdown, with the existing generated/external segment rules still winning (for example a generated-doc tree classifies generated, a vendored tree classifies external). All-code-included holds: every accepted markdown file is scanned and filtered by code_type, never excluded. AC: an ordinary README.md classifies docs; a markdown file under gen/ classifies generated; both remain in the graph.
